model_output.campaign_summary: The threat actor EXILIADOS (alias Straightonnumberone) launched an active affiliate recruitment campaign for Moondancer, a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) platform targeting critical infrastructure organizations across Latin America (excluding healthcare). The group seeks to recruit Initial Access Brokers, advanced penetesting operators, and specialized developers to execute BigGame Hunting operations, offering revenue sharing and real-time technical support. This structured affiliate model represents a significant escalation in operational capability for Colombia and the broader region, with early recruitment activity detected on Telegram and the darkforums.ru platform beginning August 16, 2026.
